summary: Iter113 retest of iter112 action items + signed-in-shell UI coverage. ALL 4 prior action items are CLOSED. Backend: re-ran 32 iter112 tests + 23 iter108 tests in isolation → 55/55 pass. Proxy chain works: POST http://localhost:3000/api/app/v2/orders/calculate with a Bearer token returns 200 and a server-priced ₹1,060.5 breakdown. Login button guard is genuinely fixed — clicking [data-testid="login-send-code-btn"] with an EMPTY or 14-char GSTIN triggers ZERO network requests. Signed-in shell fully verified via Supabase session injection into localStorage: Stock (16 SKUs, per-size names, '2 of 16 SKUs available' header, 'Only 7 pcs left' nudge on royal-kewda-b2b, 'Unavailable' on 0-stock rows, search filter, plus button), Order Pad (0.5-box halves working, badge increments, PRICED BY AAROHMM Subtotal/GST/Total shown as server value NOT 'Not Found'), full end-to-end place-order flow (Place → order-placed-screen with number B2B-20260928-0D94FB → 'View my orders' lands on Orders with new order at top ₹1,060.5 FY 2026-27 → pad-empty on return), Orders (FY chips 'All years' + 'FY 2026-27', N orders · ₹X billed summary), More (profile 'Login ID (GSTIN): 29AAAAA0000A1Z5' + all five menu items navigate), Grievance (screen, category chips, subject/message/submit, past tickets history), Schemes (empty state 'No schemes running right now'), Brochure endpoint returns PDF 200. Product sync key fix confirmed: app_products has exactly 16 rows keyed on `id`; bold-bakhoor-b2b and bold-bakhoor-200-b2b are separate SKUs with pieces_per_carton 12 vs 16; royal-kewda-b2b stock 7. Web portal not broken by shared-config changes: /, /products, /blog, /retailer/login, /wholesale all 200; POST /api/retailer-auth/login (07AAAAA0000A1Z5/Test@12345) → 200 with token. Mobile viewport 390x844 forced successfully this iteration.

minor.issue: 5 TestSpoofingRegressionInProcess tests + 2 downstream tests FAIL when run in the same pytest process AFTER test_iter112_mobile_app.py, but PASS in isolation. Order-dependent state pollution (TestClient app-instance / patched requests session). Pre-existing infra issue; not a regression from iter113 code changes. Consider adding a module-scoped fixture to reset patches, or run the suites in separate pytest invocations.

action_items: (NON-BLOCKING) test_iter110_waitlist_email_notifications.py::TestSpoofingRegressionInProcess is order-dependent when run alongside test_iter112_mobile_app.py in a single pytest process — 5 tests fail. They pass individually. Likely cause: patched module state (requests session or app instance) not reset between suites. Add a module-scoped autouse fixture that undoes the patches, or run the suites in separate pytest invocations. Not a product bug.

(HOUSEKEEPING, unchanged from iter112) Custom SMTP for Supabase Auth (Resend) still pending user action — real retailers are rate-limited to ~2 OTP emails per hour project-wide until this is configured in the Supabase dashboard.

(CODE-HYGIENE) 70 pre-existing DeprecationWarnings (Pydantic V1 @validator, FastAPI @app.on_event) still emitted per test run — flagged again from iter111/iter112. No new ones introduced this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: services/supabase_app_sync.py sync_products key change from `product_id` → `id` is correct and prevents the SKU-collapse bug. Consider adding a Supabase-side unique index and a sync assertion (expected row count == b2b_products count) so a future regression fails loudly instead of silently zeroing stock.

mobile/lib/api.ts resolveBase() returning '' unconditionally on web is the right call for both localhost and preview hosts (same-origin /api proxy). Add a jsdoc note that this is INTENTIONAL and EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL is deliberately ignored on web so nobody 'fixes' it back.

next.config.js afterFiles rewrites: /app-preview → /app-preview/index.html. This works but is fragile against renaming the export dir. Consider extracting the mount path to a constant shared with app.json's experiments.baseUrl.

mobile app screens' submit handlers now early-return on their own guards (login/pad/support/grievance) — good defence for react-native-web. Consider extracting a `useSubmitOnce({guard, action})` hook so all four handlers share the same pattern and any new screen inherits it.

Order placement UX: the pad button spinner stays visible ~8s during order placement in the web preview. Consider a client-side timeout + retry with idempotency (client_ref already supported server-side).

app_products / b2b_products: no server-side check that pieces_per_carton and stock_pieces come from the correct row after the sync-key fix. A cheap invariant test (bold-bakhoor-b2b.pieces_per_carton == 12 AND bold-bakhoor-200-b2b.pieces_per_carton == 16) would catch a future regression at test time.

success_rate.backend: 100% in isolation (55/55 iter112+iter108, 9/9 iter110). Combined 3-suite run: 92.2% (59/64) — 5 order-dependent failures pre-existing.
success_rate.frontend: 100% — all reviewed flows verified (login guard, stock, pad, place-order e2e, orders FY chips, more menu, grievance, schemes, brochure, web portal).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend and mobile app (web preview) are production-quality. The signed-in-shell verification recipe: session-inject the value from /app/memory/.qa_refresh_token via `curl POST /auth/v1/token?grant_type=refresh_token` (single-use, REWRITE the new refresh_token back), build the Supabase JS localStorage payload {access_token, refresh_token, expires_at, expires_in, token_type, user}, page.evaluate window.localStorage.setItem('sb-qzzwaqwgzvrdecheunpn-auth-token', payload), reload. Only real blocker for further work is custom Supabase SMTP (user action). Note: order-dependent pytest failure between test_iter110 and test_iter112 — run them in separate invocations, or fix module-scoped patches in iter110's TestSpoofingRegressionInProcess.
rca_of_the_issue: iter112's TWO unresolved items are fully closed: (1) 'Not Found' in login card → root cause was baked-in EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL pointing at an unreachable Render URL; fix = lib/api.ts resolveBase() returns '' on web unconditionally, so web bundle always hits same-origin /api proxy → uvicorn 8001. Verified end-to-end. (2) login button not really disabled on react-native-web → root cause was Pressable's `disabled` prop being style-only on web; fix = handler-level early-return in login/pad/support/grievance. Verified: 0 network requests on empty & 14-char GSTIN. Additionally, the sync_products key bug (product_id → id) that collapsed 16 SKUs to 9 and zeroed real stock is fixed and verified (16 rows, per-size differentiation, correct pieces_per_carton per size). The one remaining minor is a pytest order-dependency in iter110's spoofing regression module — pre-existing test-infra issue, not a product regression.
